title: [intraday-reply-dust] replyDustManifestKey: characterization test for the manifest key of a session
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for replyDustManifestKey in src/intraday-reply-dust.ts: manifest key per session
- replyDustManifestKey("2026-01-05") is "permanent/intraday-reply-dust/2026-01-05/manifest.json"
- replyDustManifestKey("bad") throws INVALID_SESSION_DATE

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v1): Peace's task (source: peace). The intraday manifest key (and its INVALID_SESSION_DATE guard through sessionPrefix) has no test; this pins its current behaviour. Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed. The running scanner chain is unchanged. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS 47cfaaf built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v1); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with replyDustManifestKey stubbed); suite 556/556 with all six new tests of this batch, all 4 typechecks ok. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
